items.name: Sencha Uji 50g
items.blurb: Grassy steamed green tea. Morning cup for people who already drink green tea.

items.name: Darjeeling First Flush 50g
items.blurb: Light black tea with muscatel notes. Works as a thoughtful gift.

items.name: Tieguan Yin 40g
items.blurb: Rolled oolong. For someone who wants to slow down and brew in infusions.

items.name: Houjicha 50g
items.blurb: Roasted green tea, low caffeine. Evening cup without herbal territory.

items.name: Camomila Floral 30g
items.blurb: Caffeine-free chamomile blend. Comfort cup, not a medical product.

items.name: Rooibos Citrus 40g
items.blurb: Red bush with citrus peel. Caffeine-free daily driver.

items.name: Kyusu 250ml
items.blurb: Side-handle teapot. Pairs with sencha or houjicha.

items.name: Chaleira de precisao 0.8L
items.blurb: Gooseneck kettle with temperature hold. The usual upgrade after a tasting kit.

items.name: Kit degustacao (3 amostras)
items.blurb: Three 10g samples. Default recommendation when taste is still open.

items.name: Caixa presente iniciante
items.blurb: Sampler plus a small teapot. One-box gift when the recipient is new to tea.
